notes.title: Incubo Now on Mobile & Get Ready for Our Next Big Reveal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34080396/b0bbff73703b7f9979c62c358558906883cbc9c4.png[/img]


[h3][b]Big News, Gamers![/b][/h3]

[h1][b]Incubo[/b][/h1] is now up for [b]pre-registration[/b] on the [b]Play Store and TapTap[/b]! Dive into the eerie world of Incubo and be one of the first to experience the chills and thrills. Secure your spot now and get ready for an adventure like no other!
[previewyoutube=itNwhcJAz_A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[h1][b]But that's not all![/b][/h1] We’re on the verge of revealing our [b]next project[/b] ][b]—a brand-new[/b] [h1][b]interactive supernatural romance visual novel[/b][/h1] coming soon to [b]Steam![/b] If you're into captivating stories, mysterious romances, and spine-tingling supernatural elements, you won’t want to miss this. [b]Stay tuned[/b] for more details, and get ready to fall in love with the unknown!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Lately we have received input from players that the controller uses the keyboard is hard to play. In update 1.1, we tried modifying the controller by adding an alternate button on keyboard. And fixed some minor bugs.

Once again we are very grateful for the reports from the players about Incubo.

Best Regards,
Hehe Gamez

notes.title: Update 1.094
notes.content:
Thank you very much for the feedback. We have made several updates. This update (build 1.094) fixes various issues and adjusting stage difficulty. Here are the changes and the improvements that are made:

Changes:
-. Reduced difficulty on Yurei stage
-. Reduced difficulty on clown boss stage
-. Adjusted ropes position on clown boss stage

Bug fixes:
-. Fixed bugs that make player dead when skip cutscene at "line up properly" stage

Thank you for your support ! 

Best Regards,
Hehe Gamez
